{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates by patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
print("\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", data['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0]).sum())
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_final:", data['biomarker_final'].isin([-999.0]).sum())

# Check distribution of severity and arm
print("\nArm distribution:")
print(data['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(data['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if severity is balanced across arms
print("\nSeverity by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity']))"}
